title: Middle-Overs Spin: Can Gujarat Titans Create Pressure Without Immediate Wickets?
dek: Can Gujarat Titans' spinners squeeze an innings without taking wickets? Dot-ball rates and economy in the middle overs since 2022 measure the pressure they create.
excerpt: Gujarat Titans' middle-overs spin has been in line with the rest of the league's since 2022. Pressure without wickets is real, but it has to be measured in dots and runs, not reputation.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: The Squeeze Theory
body: The case for middle-overs spin is pressure: a run of dot balls forces a batter to take a risk, and the wicket follows, sometimes off the next bowler. If the theory holds, a spinner can be valuable without a big wicket tally.
Since 2022, with bowling type known from player-bio data, Gujarat Titans' spinners have conceded {{ev:mos-te}} an over in overs seven to fifteen against {{ev:mos-le}} for the rest of the league.

sections.heading: Dots as the Currency of Pressure
body: Gujarat Titans' spinners have bowled dot balls on {{ev:mos-td}} of their middle-overs deliveries, against {{ev:mos-ld}} for the rest of the IPL. Spin has taken {{ev:mos-share}} of the franchise's typed middle-overs balls, against {{ev:mos-lshare}} elsewhere.
{{ev:mos-lead}} has carried the biggest middle-overs spin workload since 2022, at an economy of {{ev:mos-lead-econ}}.

sections.heading: Using Spin to Set Up Wickets
body: If spin squeezes and pace strikes, the order of bowlers matters: a tight spell from a spinner is most useful immediately before a wicket-taking seamer returns.
For GT the measurable test is what happens in the over after a spinner's dot-heavy over, a pattern that the ball-by-ball data can track.

sections.heading: Pressure Can Be an Illusion
body: A low economy in the middle overs may reflect batters choosing to consolidate rather than spinners forcing them to. Without measuring what the following overs yield, the squeeze cannot be proven.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Measure the Squeeze
body: Gujarat Titans' spin has been in line with the league's in the middle overs since 2022. The franchise should value spinners on dot rate and economy, and test whether their dot-heavy overs lead to wickets for the next bowler.
That would turn the squeeze from a cliché into a number the selectors can use.
